Subject: Post-call: deployment criteria & evidence requests for ZenHealth

Thanks for taking the call earlier, Samir and Leah — good conversation. Quick recap + concrete asks so we can move the procurement thread along.

Key notes from call:
- Primary requirement: PHI handling for telehealth transcripts and clinical notes. ZenHealth must be HIPAA-covered and require a signed BAA.
- Primary deployment preference: evaluate Hosted API first (fastest), but logistics may push to Dedicated or Private VPC depending on evidence and procurement timeline.
- Non-negotiables: SOC 2 Type II, encryption at rest with KMS customer-managed option, tenant isolation (for Dedicated) or VPC peering (for Private).

Action items for ZenHealth (ask of you):
1) Confirm whether procurement needs a signed BAA now or after SOC2 verification.
2) Share any specific audit items (data residency, logging retention windows, or vendor questionnaire items) we should prioritize.
3) If you have a target date for go-live, share it — we want to size timeline/cost.

What we'll send you by EOD tomorrow:
- SOC2 Type II excerpt and summary of control coverage (pdf)
- Draft BAA for your legal team to review (docx)
- Short comparison sheet: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (pdf) with expected lead times and ballpark delta in monthly cost

If helpful, proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min follow-up with procurement/legal to run through SOC2 & BAA (I can join)
- Parallel technical session with Marissa (solutions) to walk network/VPC options and timeline.

Proposed times for follow-up (PST): Tue 11/18 10:00 AM or Wed 11/19 2:00 PM. Open to other times.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

--

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses below.

1) BAA: procurement/legal want to see SOC2 first but will want the BAA signed before production. So please send SOC2 excerpts first; we should have legal review the draft BAA concurrently.

2) Audit items: our key asks are:
   - Data residency: US-only (we will confirm region)
   - Audit logs: immutable audit logs for all model invocations (90 days minimum; longer is a plus)
   - Encryption: at rest + TLS in transit; ability to use our KMS or HSM is preferred

3) Timeline: target pilot start Jan 10, 2027. Procurement wants procurement & security sign-off by end-of-December if possible.

Preference on deployment mode: if SOC2 + BAA + KMS options check out, Hosted API is acceptable for pilot. If any control gaps show up or if the procurement/legal team insists, we'll evaluate Dedicated or Private VPC.

Please also include ballpark lead times for Dedicated and Private (we know private will take longer). Also confirm what evidence Redwood needs from us for VPC/on-prem networking (eg. firewall rules, IP ranges, MSA contact).

Thanks — Samir
